_doc: Frag Grenade (attacker pool; research/gadgets.md §3.4). Thrown; it bounces; a 4 s fuse that drops to 2 s at the first bounce when more is left; it can't be cooked (Y8S4). Its size is a placeholder. Its blast: 150 hp (a placeholder: Fandom's numbers are from before Y6S3) within 1.5 m (ours), none past 3.6 m (Y7S3's non-lethal and destruction radius); it cuts soft surfaces within 1 m (ours); 70 % of its damage gets through each soft surface on the way (ours, RealBlast's shrapnel).
name: Frag Grenade
